user.title: CentralHome
user.description: Adds the CentralHome dashboard and its theme. Next: Settings, Dashboards, Add dashboard, CentralHome.

themes_non_charges.title: The CentralHome theme could not be loaded
themes_non_charges.description:
The CentralHome dashboard works, but without its colours. To get them back, add these two lines to configuration.yaml, then restart Home Assistant:

```yaml
frontend:
  themes: !include_dir_merge_named themes
```
